about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh captures for Tenshu Control (`captured`, from the UI tests in `uiTests`), and the names reserved for screens no pipeline captures yet (`planned`). The support pages' shot: slots may name only these; web/apex/support-pages/screens.test.ts and the screenshot script check against this file. Adding a capture means adding it here. `appearances`: the system appearances the pipeline captures every `captured` screen in (scripts/store-screenshots.sh --appearance); light is the default and the published key form, dark is keyed `…/<lang>/dark/NN-screen`, and a support page falls back to light where no dark capture is published. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-welcome.shows: Welcome to Tenshu: "Start fresh on this device", "I have Tenshu on another device", "Recover from a recovery phrase"

02-protected.shows: "Protected by your device" after Start fresh, with Continue (which creates the realm)

03-recovery-phrase.shows: "You're set up": the Turn on sync link, the 24-word recovery phrase, "I've saved it"

04-home.shows: Home: the realm's recent events (Drive's uploads)

05-devices.shows: Settings → This realm's devices: the device list and sync status

06-settings.shows: Settings: Storage, Shares, devices, Add a device, Recovery phrase, app lock

07-storage.shows: Settings → Storage: the Free plan, the account and the storage used

08-sign-in.shows: Turn on sync → "Sign in or create your free Tenshu account", with an empty email field

09-add-device.shows: Settings → Add a device, on "Show a code": the QR code and the manual pairing code

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, keyed android/phone/<lang>/[dark/]NN-screen. Same names as iOS for the same screen; a name new to Android must also be listed in captured or planned above, so a number never means two screens.
